Complete the sentences with the correct reflexive pronouns.

atoms.sound: When he was shaving, my dad cut himself.

atoms.a: I've decided to spend more time by ...
atoms.sound: I’ve decided to spend more time by myself.

atoms.a: You're old enough to make breakfast by ...
atoms.sound: You’re old enough to make breakfast by yourself.

atoms.a: They have done all the work by ...
atoms.sound: They have done all the work by themselves.

instruction.text: Drag the words into the correct group.

hint.text: If the word replaces a noun, it can stand by itself and is a possessive pronoun. If the word comes before a noun, it is a possessive determiner.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct relative pronoun.

atoms.b: We’re looking for someone ((++who whom)) could babysit my little sister tomorrow.
This is a poem ((++whose that)) author is unknown.
My dad works in a clinic ((++that whose)) specialises in helping people with asthma.
I’m not sure ((++whom whose)) this umbrella belongs to.
I finally watched the film ((++that who)) you recommended.
